title: LMCache: An Efficient KV Cache Layer for Enterprise-Scale LLM Inference
technique: Open-source KV cache layer: extracts KV from vLLM/SGLang, stores/shares across GPU/CPU/disk/remote tiers via batched, pipelined data movement with a connector and control API; supports CPU offloading, cross-engine prefix reuse, and PD disaggregation transfer

optimized_metrics.evidence: Our evaluation shows that combining LMCache with vLLM achieves up to 15x improvement in throughput across workloads such as multi-round question answering and document analysis.

headline_claim.text: combining LMCache with vLLM achieves up to 15x improvement in throughput across workloads such as multi-round question answering and document analysis.

reported_metrics.where: §8.1: 2.3-14x higher query processing rate at the same TTFT; 1.3-3x on real trace
§9 lessons: context truncation halves prefix cache hit ratio
Table on achieved bandwidth, Fig 14 delay breakdown

metric_definitions.definition_quote: time-to-first-token (TTFT), which is the prefill delay
metric_definitions.notes: Defined only as 'prefill delay'; with QPS sweeps under queueing it effectively includes waiting, but not stated.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: inter-token-latency (ITL), which is the average delay between the generation of two consecutive output tokens
metric_definitions.notes: Mean of per-token gaps; note ITL is shown to be inflated by baseline slow prefill queueing subsequent decodes.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: LMCache achieves 2.3-14x higher query processing rate (i.e., throughput), at the same TTFT, than the strongest baseline across five evaluated models.
metric_definitions.notes: Throughput is read off TTFT-vs-QPS curves: the QPS sustainable at a fixed TTFT, i.e. SLO-style capacity; not tokens/s.

slo_spec: No explicit SLO; throughput compared 'at the same TTFT' read from latency-vs-QPS curves; mentions user-configurable latency SLO for replication in design (§ about data placement)
load_regime: QPS sweep of multi-round chat / document-analysis workloads (10K-20K-token contexts, 100-token outputs), real company trace over days, PD-disaggregation random 8K-in/200-out benchmark
tradeoff_acknowledged: Remote/storage backends add loading latency that can exceed prefill for short contexts; lower TTFT only when cache hit and bandwidth sufficient; context truncation destroys prefix hits.
hardware: 8xH100 server (GMI Cloud); B200 for context-length study; NVLink between prefiller/decoder
models: Llama 3.1 70B, Qwen2.5-Coder-32B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen3-Coder-480B, others (five models)
workloads: multi-round QA, document analysis, real production trace, random 8K/200 PD benchmark
extractor_notes: Systems/experience paper; objectives are throughput at fixed TTFT plus TTFT/ITL reductions, not a formal objective. Headline 'throughput' is QPS at same TTFT.
